# FaithShield Insurance

> Mortgage protection and life insurance for Florida families from Rhina Delgado, a licensed insurance broker in Florida (life, health and variable annuities). Faith-driven, no-pressure guidance in English and Spanish. Based in Naples, Florida, serving families across Florida.

## Key facts
- Broker: Rhina Delgado (also known as Rhina Jasmyn), licensed insurance broker in Florida, founder of FaithShield Insurance
- Specialty: mortgage protection insurance for Florida homeowners; also term life, whole life, final expense, disability income and annuities
- PMI protects the lender, not the family. Mortgage protection pays the family so they can keep the home.
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Phone / text: (239) 451-5994
- Book a call: https://calendly.com/faithshieldinsurance
